backend_url.description: The HTTPS base URL of your Vobiz calling backend, with no trailing slash — for example https://calling.example.com. See docs/backend-contract.md in the repository for what this service must implement.

agent_id.description: Which agent identity this installation registers as. Your calling backend maps this value to a SIP user. Each agent must use a different value, or calls will ring the wrong person.

registrar_url.description: SIP-over-WebSocket URL of the Vobiz registrar. Leave blank unless Vobiz support has given you a different one.
